#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long mod = 998244353LL;
const int MAX = 400010;
long long fact[MAX];
long long invFact[MAX];

long long modPow(long long a, long long n) {
    if (n == 0) return 1LL;
    long long half = modPow(a, n / 2);
    half = half * half % mod;
    if (n & 1) half = half * a % mod;
    return half;
}

struct Triplet {
    long long gcd, x, y;
    Triplet(long long gcd, long long x, long long y) : gcd(gcd), x(x), y(y) {}
};

Triplet extendedGcd(long long a, long long b) {
    if (a == 0) return Triplet(b, 0, 1);
    Triplet t = extendedGcd(b % a, a);
    long long x = t.y - (b / a) * t.x;
    long long y = t.x;
    return Triplet(t.gcd, x, y);
}

long long modInv(long long a, long long m) {
    Triplet t = extendedGcd(a, m);
    if (t.gcd != 1) return -1;
    return (t.x % m + m) % m;
}

void precompute() {
    fact[0] = fact[1] = invFact[0] = invFact[1] = 1LL;
    for (int i = 2; i < MAX; i++) {
        fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * (long long)i) % mod;
        invFact[i] = (invFact[i - 1] * modInv(i, mod)) % mod;
    }
}

long long nCr(int n, int r) {
    long long res = fact[n] * invFact[r] % mod;
    res = res * invFact[n - r] % mod;
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    precompute();
    
    int n;
    long long k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << fact[n] << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    if (n <= k) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    
    long long comb = nCr(n, (int)k);
    int cols = n - (int)k;
    long long sum = 0LL;
    
    for (int i = 0; i <= cols; i++) {
        long long term = nCr(cols, i);
        term = term * modPow(cols - i, n) % mod;
        if (i & 1) {
            sum -= term;
            if (sum < 0) sum += mod;
        } else {
            sum += term;
            if (sum >= mod) sum -= mod;
        }
    }
    
    cout << (2LL * ((comb * sum) % mod)) % mod << "\n";
    
    return 0;
}
